1) Searches the title to confirm the seller can legally sell the home. 2) Reviews your agreement and your mortgage instructions from the lender. 3) Arranges title insurance and prepares to register the transfer. 4) Prepares a statement showing the exact amount you owe on closing.

Save this for your closing week. Steps vary by purchase. General information only, not legal, tax or mortgage advice.

Is the GTA slowing? September's numbers.

TRREB reported 5,040 GTA home sales in September 2026, down 9% from September 2025. New listings were 16,500, down 14.4% year over year, and the MLS® Home Price Index Composite benchmark was down 4.7% year over year. The average selling price was $1,006,409. Source: TRREB Market Watch, September 2026 (released Oct 6, 2026). General information only, not advice.
